## SUBJECT
Following Up: ML Engineer Application - Gaurav Raii

## MESSAGE
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to express my continued strong interest in the ML Engineer position at Anthropic, for which I recently applied. My background as an ML Engineer and AI Model Quality Analyst aligns well with the innovative work you do.

I am particularly excited by Anthropic's mission and believe my skills in model evaluation and data analysis would be a valuable asset. I am eager to learn more about this opportunity.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to hearing from you soon.

Sincerely,
Gaurav Raii
